name: Rainbow Sprinkle Birthday Cake
description: A multi-layered colorful vanilla sponge cake smothered in fluffy strawberry frosting and covered with a waterfall of rainbow sprinkles!

name: Choco-Saurus Dino Cake
description: Rich chocolate fudge cake with cute hand-drawn marshmallow dinosaurs stomping through chocolate soil cookie crumbs!

name: Magical Unicorn Fantasy Cake
description: Swirly pastel pink and lavender buttercream with a golden chocolate horn, fluffy marshmallow ears, and starry sprinkles.

name: Under-the-Sea Adventure
description: Ocean-blue vanilla frosting with hand-sculpted white-chocolate starfish, cute icing octopuses, and golden graham-cracker beach sand.

name: Space Cadet Rocket Cake
description: Midnight-dark cocoa cake with colorful frosting planets, candy stars, and a cute strawberry rocket blasting off!

name: Princess Tiara Pink Palace
description: Double chocolate cake with fresh strawberry filling, wrapped in a pink royal icing tiara and sparkly sugar pearls.

name: Teddy Bear Picnic Cake
description: Fluffy honey-cinnamon sponge shaped like a cozy sleeping teddy bear with a mini hand-drawn waffle blanket and honey-drizzle details.

name: Cookie Monster Fudge Cake
description: Deep-blue cookies-and-cream cake topped with mini chocolate-chip cookies and funny marshmallow googly eyes!
